description: This file defines the 'SugarDependentDropdown' class, which manages metadata and functionality for dependent dropdown elements in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for initialization, validation, and processing of dropdown metadata, supporting dynamic form elements in the CRM interface.

classes.name: SugarDependentDropdown
classes.description: Handles metadata for dependent dropdowns, including validation, initialization, and debugging utilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally initializes the object with metadata file.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Loads and processes metadata from a specified PHP file.

methods.name: isValidElement
methods.description: Checks if a given element array has all required fields.

methods.name: initElement
methods.description: Initializes and merges defaults into a dropdown element, including its handlers.

methods.name: verifyMetadata
methods.description: Verifies the correctness and completeness of the metadata structure.
